site: East New Haven Avenue in Historic Downtown Melbourne
about: The host promotes the parade as one of Melbourne's holiday traditions in the historic downtown district, with floats, bands, performers and a visit from Santa.
A parade page from the organizers on social media lists the start at 10 AM at 801 E New Haven Ave, and the downtown calendar lists the day as running to 1 PM.
Downtown Melbourne's own calendar shows the listing as Free and invites everyone to bring the whole family.
Other Downtown Melbourne holiday listings for the same weekend include a Ghosts of Christmas Past history tour on December 11 and the Cookie Crawl on December 12.
Downtown Melbourne is run by Melbourne Main Street, which lists its office at 2004 Vernon Place and a phone number of 321.724.1741.
The parade listing names the presenting sponsor as American Air, Plumbing and Electric, according to the organizers' event post.
The organizers' event post is titled Downtown Melbourne Christmas Parade, and more than 1,000 people had responded to it by the time we checked.
Other Melbourne holiday dates in the same season include the Downtown Melbourne tree lighting and Breakfast with Santa on December 5, and Brevard Zoo's Jolly Days from December 19.
faq: Is the Melbourne Christmas parade free?
Yes. The Downtown Melbourne calendar lists the parade as Free.
What time is the parade?
Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 10 AM to 1 PM.
Where is it?
Along East New Haven Avenue in Historic Downtown Melbourne, FL 32901.
Will Santa be there?
Yes. The host lists Santa among the parade features.
What will we see?
Festive floats, bands, performers and Santa, according to the host.
Who runs it?
The listing is on the Downtown Melbourne calendar, which Melbourne Main Street operates.

about: The zoo describes the evening as a night off for parents, with kids dropped off for animal encounters, games, crafts and pizza.
Pricing is split by membership: $34 for members and $40 for nonmembers, bought through the zoo's online ticket page.
Brevard Zoo's calendar for the same month lists Jolly Days on Saturday, December 19, where kids can meet Santa and Mrs. Claus and watch the animals unwrap holiday treats.
A Holly Jolly Brunch follows on Sunday, December 20 at the Nyami Nyami River Lodge, and the zoo's new Holiday Lights night experience features about 1 million lights.
Noon Year's Eve on December 31 includes a ball drop at noon and a sparkling juice toast, with activities included in daytime zoo admission.
faq: How much is the Kids' Holiday Hangout?
$34 for zoo members and $40 for nonmembers.
What time is drop off and pick up?
The program runs Saturday, December 12, 2026 from 5 to 8 PM.
What do kids do?
Up-close animal encounters, holiday themed games, crafts and a pizza dinner.
Where is it held?
At Brevard Zoo, 8225 N Wickham Rd, Melbourne, FL 32940.
How do I register?
Tickets are sold through the zoo's online ticket page linked from the event listing.
Are parents included?
The zoo describes it as a drop off program so parents can enjoy a night out.

about: Melbourne Main Street calls the evening its third annual Cookie Crawl and says downtown is baking, with each guest filling a keepsake tin from shop to shop.
The $25 ticket covers the tin and cookies from participating downtown businesses. Tickets are sold through the Main Street ticket page.
Santa and Mrs. Claus, the Grinch and photo stops are part of the evening, and shops stay open for candlelight shopping until 8 PM.
The organizers say the crawl sold out last year and recommend buying tickets early.
A Very American Christmas Parade runs earlier the same day, from 10 AM to 1 PM on East New Haven Avenue.
Melbourne Main Street lists its office at 2004 Vernon Place, the same address used for tin pick-up, and a phone number of 321.724.1741.
The Main Street calendar notes that the 2025 crawl sold out, and the 2026 tickets are sold in advance online.
Other December dates on the same downtown calendar include a Ghosts of Christmas Past haunting holiday history tour on December 11 and a Green Gables Open House on December 12.
faq: How much is the Cookie Crawl?
$25 per ticket.
When is it?
Saturday, December 12, 2026 from 4 to 8 PM.
Where do I pick up my tin?
At 2004 Vernon Place in Historic Downtown Melbourne.
Will Santa be there?
Yes. The host lists photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus and the Grinch.
Can I buy tickets at the event?
The host directs guests to buy tickets online and says the event sold out last year.
Are there character photos?
Yes. The host lists photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus and the Grinch.
